selection.purpose: Initial-control restoration on the accepted native map using model-generated noiseless observations.

forward_map.precision: internal FP64 continuous state carry; declare existing FP32 cotangent handoffs
forward_map.control_boundary: solver entry after WRF initialization and CQ; no initialization-map differentiation

reuse_requires: same internal FP64 control boundary and continuous carry

observations.theta_definition: T + 300 K in the registered dry case; not air temperature
observations.H: select directly at each field native stagger; no destaggering or interpolation
observations.HT: scatter-add to identical packed slots; theta constant has zero derivative
observations.index_basis: one-based ordinal within each field physical owned unique box; not memory/halo/packed indices
observations.coordinates_source: matched runtime grid/layout; do not equate U/V/mass coordinates at the same ordinal
observations.weight_meaning: fixed research residual scaling, not estimated physical observation error; never forecast epsilon

controls.P: [p_wind,p_theta], full packed physical templates including authoritative boundary extension
controls.mode_precision: freeze actual representable templates and control-state construction before runs

wind.U: negative adjacent-corner forward y difference divided by dy
wind.V: adjacent-corner forward x difference divided by dx

theta.pressure: current EOS diagnostic, not externally fixed

controls.boundary_policy: generate unique owners then use existing periodic/symmetric/antisymmetric extension; exact V=0 at walls; zero changes to W/PH bottom and all other fields
required_preflight: generate and hash P/Z_b; verify nonzero finite norms and common wind normalization
check boundary aliases and physically admissible controlled states
verify actual applied perturbations and use identical P in P^T*lambda0

objective.injection: once at each specified accepted endpoint; add midpoint to propagated terminal value

identifiability.method: reuse two-axis observation central differences at both frozen widths; report both SVDs
identifiability.unresolved_or_failed_action: do not start optimizer; new observation/control version required; do not tune this version after results
identifiability.require_ratio_on: both frozen FD widths at E1 start

control_gradient_check.additional_resolution_requirement: actual input perturbation nonzero and FD signal resolved above measured solver variability; freeze evaluation policy before runs

E1.optimizer: reuse an existing minimization implementation after caller audit; identity/settings must be frozen before run
separately_counted_preflight: two axes times two widths times plus/minus = 8 FD forward evaluations
at most one new truth forward if needed
E1.replay_accounting: log all gradient calls/prefix replays/steps/wall time separately; optimizer gradient/replay hard caps must be frozen before execution
E1.budget_exhaustion_status: incomplete; no automatic budget extension or retuning
E1.objective_evaluation_budget_scope: E1 optimizer only; E0/FD/possible one truth run counted separately; all adjoint prefix replays separately logged and capped before execution

withheld_validation.region: same whole physical owners as registered forward acceptance: exclude U periodic duplicate and W/PH fixed bottom, retain V physical walls and W/PH dynamic top
withheld_validation.per_field_report: physical-unit RMS; near-zero background field errors reported absolutely, not unstable relative improvement
withheld_validation.acceptance_at_each_time: E_t_final<=0.5*E_t_background, with resolved positive background composite
withheld_validation.unobserved_positions: per-field physical owner complement of the observation mask at that time

E2.reuse: cached states/residuals and local observation/transpose/caller checks

mutations.expect: nonzero expected midpoint cotangent missing; component injection/derivative check fails
current accepted step or observation ID/step does not match128; explicit rejection
endpoint contribution count is not exactly one; explicit rejection
injected weights differ from declared residual/sigma^2; component check fails

E2.component_rule: total-gradient pass cannot conceal missing/unresolved midpoint contribution

do_not_require: probabilistic certification from one noise realization

pre_execution_freeze_gates: truth/source/executable/settings/auxiliary-state/precision reuse receipt or one new truth trajectory
control-mode generator, actual P/Z_b/control construction, observation384row coordinates/slots/values and hashes
existing minimizer identity, box/line-search rules and gradient/prefix replay hard caps
implemented metric and signal/solver-resolution checks, E2 expected failures, all acceptance settings/hash manifest

completion.claim: Correct native initial-control / forward / H / adjoint / minimizer / state-restoration connection within this declared dry case
